↗ ex:8-3 8-2. EULER's HOMOGENEOUS FUNCTION THEOREM: Let $c$ be a real number, and let $f : {\mathbb {R}}^{n} \smallsetminus \{ 0\} \rightarrow \mathbb {R}$ be a smooth function that is positively homogeneous of degree $c$ , meaning that $f\left( {\lambda x}\right) = {\lambda }^{c}f\left( x\right)$ for all $\lambda > 0$ and $x \in {\mathbb {R}}^{n} \smallsetminus \{ 0\} $ . Prove that ${Vf} = {cf}$ , where $V$ is the Euler vector field defined in Example 8.3. (Used on p. 248.) \end{exercise}
